errors.evidence: The description lists the country Slovenia twice. The last country on the x-axis is Slovakia (Словакия), not Slovenia (Словения).

The description omits a part of the y-axis label. The full label is 'Общо работни часове на седмица, включително извънреден труд (средно)', which translates to 'Total weekly working hours, including overtime (average)'. The omission of 'including overtime' is a factual inaccuracy.
The description completely omits the data for one of the countries shown in the chart: France (Франция).

errors.text_span: Стълбите за Хърватия са с височина 42.13 за мъже и 37 за жени.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly reports the data for Croatia. The values listed (42.13 for men and 37 for women) actually belong to France. The correct value for men in Croatia is 42.15.

errors.text_span: Стълбите за Словения са с височина 43.13 за мъже и 40.4 за жени.
errors.evidence: This sentence reports the data for the last country, which is Slovakia (Словакия), but incorrectly identifies it as Slovenia (Словения).
